description:
In dkim.rs::has_dkim_signature_header, the code correctly finds header_end (

 or 

 separator) and only scans header_bytes = &article_bytes[..header_end]. However the or_else fallback for 

 uses windows(2).position() which runs over the FULL article first -- only the position is then taken. For an article with no 

, the 

 search starts from position 0 in the full article. If the body contains 'DKIM-Signature:' preceded by a blank line, the body-check guard would still be correct because header_bytes is sliced using the found position. On careful re-read this looks correct, but there is a subtle issue: for 

 detection,  points to just after the blank line (p + 2). If there is NO separator at all,  is used, meaning the entire byte slice (including body) is scanned for DKIM-Signature. The intent says 'in the header section' but the fallback silently scans the whole article when the separator is absent.
title: verify: DKIM header check scans full article bytes, not just header section
